liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jam #1 (Fire On The Mountain theme)** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the first and second jams tight; Reviewer hears hints of Fire on the Mountain in the opening jam [4][6]
- **Wall Song** (2 reviews): The roughly half-hour Wall Song is called melodic and exploratory; Reviewer notes Wall Song runs about thirty minutes [3][12]
- **Jam #2** (1 review): Reviewer thinks Jam 2 sounds like San Francisco Bay [11]
- **Jam #3** (1 review): Reviewer identifies Jam 3 as Hide Away [11]
- **Ghost Riders In The Sky Jam** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the twangy guitar sound and the noodly picking in this jam [10]

## Setlist highlights

- **Jam #1 (Fire On The Mountain theme)**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 4 archived performances [15]
- **Wall Song**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **Fresh Green Grass Jam**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **Wall Song**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **Jam #2**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 5 archived performances [15]
- **Noodle Part 1**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **Noodle Part 2**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [15]
- **Jam #3**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [15]

## The recordings

- **gd1971-08-21.aud.38f.83307.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 15 songs; 104 min; rated 4.57/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: This version sounds different from another copy the reviewer had, with keyboards audible; reviewer prefers it; Some songs are cut or partial on this tape [1][14]
- **gd71-08-21.hartjam.aud.17179.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 12 songs; 104 min; rated 4.35/5 by 17 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is decent in quality, but the taper repeatedly stopped and restarted between songs, leaving almost no chatter; Reviewer finds the audience recording sounds surprisingly good for a barn [3][4]

## Around the show

- Review says the jam involved Mickey, Phil, Jerry, Bob, plus guests David Crosby and John Cippolina [3]
- Reviewer values the intimate feel of the barn setting and wishes the recording were uncut [9]
- The Taper's Compendium reportedly lists Merle Saunders and Nicky Hopkins as participants [14]
- Reviewer points to the Harding Theater show as evidence that Jam 3 is Hide Away [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1971-08-21.aud.38f.83307.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by 38f; source: 1st generation reel to reel > revox > amplifiers > tascam audio cdrw750 > cd > computer > plex tool professional XL > wav > flac. [1]. Also: Comes from John Cipollina's collection; uploader copied his reel and notes, with no sound alteration or editing [1]
- **gd71-08-21.hartjam.aud.17179.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Rick; source: Audience - Sony TC-24 [2]. Also: Tape was stopped and restarted between tracks; little is lost at track starts, except perhaps the very first [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Kreitzman: [Who's Who on the Rolling Thunder Cover](https://deadessays.blogspot.com/2021/01/whos-who-on-rolling-thunder-cover.html) [16]
